info.title: 1080 Motion Public API
info.description:
To use the API you need to provide a valid 1080 API Key. The key can be created when logging in to the 1080 Web App.
When you have a key, set the X-1080-API-Key HTTP header with the API key.

To learn more, see the wiki page

get.description:
Gets the training data for the specified set.
The samples are returned as a base64 encoded binary array.
For more info about filter mode, see https://docs.1080motion.com/docs/sample-filtering

parameters.name: setId
parameters.description: Id (guid) of the set to get training data for

parameters.name: includeSamples
parameters.description:
True to also include the list of samples.
This is only needed if you need to plot the curve or perform your own advanced analysis of the samples. Otherwise, use the aggregated values that are always returned.
The samples are returned as a base64 encoded binary array. See https://github.com/1080Motion/API/wiki/DataSamples-(web-api).

parameters.name: filterMode
parameters.description:
Specifies which filter to apply to the returned samples. Note that filters are only applied to horizontal exercises (linear sprint and change of direction). Only used if includeSamples is true.
For more info about filter mode, see https://docs.1080motion.com/docs/sample-filtering

get.description:
Returns training data from all sessions matching the specified parameters.
The returned list is sorted by date, with the most recent session first.
At most 20 sessions are returned.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Optional client id. Only returns sessions for this client

parameters.name: maxAgeDays
parameters.description: Max number of days of sessions to return. Default 1 (one day/last 24 hours). Specify -1 to return all sessions ever recorded

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Return sessions newer than this data (inclusive). Use ISO_8601 format for best result

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Return sessions older than this data (inclusive). Use ISO_8601 format for best result

parameters.name: exerciseTypes
parameters.description: Optional list of exercise types to limit the search to only sessions that contain the specified exercise(s).

parameters.name: includeSamples
parameters.description:
True to also include the list of samples.
This is only needed if you need to plot the curve or perform your own advanced analysis of the samples. Otherwise, use the aggregated values that are always returned.
The samples are returned as a base64 encoded binary array. See https://github.com/1080Motion/API/wiki/DataSamples-(web-api).

parameters.name: filterMode
parameters.description:
Specifies which filter to apply to the returned samples. Note that filters are only applied to horizontal exercises (linear sprint and change of direction). Only used if includeSamples is true.
For more info about filter mode, see https://docs.1080motion.com/docs/sample-filtering

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Max number of results (sets) to return (default 20, max with samples = 50, without samples = 200)
